clearedSpotChecks.check: Which keccak routine the released X Layer node runs for KECCAK256, which hashes every pool id (src/types/PoolId.sol:14), position key (src/libraries/Position.sol:60), tick bitmap word slot (src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:70) and transient delta slot (src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:14).
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/okx/xlayer-reth/refs/heads/main/DockerfileOp on 2026-11-27: line 46 declares ARG RUSTFLAGS="", line 49 ARG FEATURES="", and line 76 runs cargo build --profile $BUILD_PROFILE --features "$FEATURES". The justfile build-docker recipe (lines 179-212) passes only the VERGEN and copilot secret arguments and removes .cargo outside dev builds; .cargo/config.toml is absent on main (HTTP 404). Only build-maxperf and install-maxperf (lines 155-174) set target-cpu=native. One correction to the reasoning: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/okx/xlayer-reth/refs/heads/main/bin/node/Cargo.toml has default = [] and asm-keccak = ["alloy-primitives/asm-keccak"], so the Docker build with FEATURES empty does not turn on asm-keccak through the node crate, and the image most likely hashes with the Rust keccak of alloy-primitives, not with sha3-asm keccak1600-x86_64. I did not confirm whether another dependency turns the feature on, and I could not confirm which workflow builds the published image (the workflow file names I tried returned 404). The conclusion holds either way: the AVX-512VL routine is reached only by maxperf source builds, and the public endpoint, which answered reth/v2.3.0-f60420a xlayer/v0.0.7 to my web3_clientVersion call, matched on every tested vector.

clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched the four Cargo.lock files on 2026-11-27 and read the pins myself. okx/xlayer-reth main and v0.0.7.3: ruint 1.18.0, revm 40.0.3, revm-interpreter 37.0.3, sha3-asm 0.1.8, alloy-primitives 1.6.0. celo-org/celo-kona celo/reth-v1.0.10: ruint 1.20.0, revm 38.0.0 and revm-interpreter 35.0.1 both from git+https://github.com/celo-org/revm?rev=bd28f9420c250df2a5c4a6d8103b51ae06b5c222, sha3-asm 0.1.6. celo-kona main: ruint 1.20.0, revm 42.0.1, revm-interpreter 42.0.0, sha3-asm 0.1.8, alloy-primitives 1.7.3. None pins ruint 1.21.0, which OPCODES.md line 122 records as the withdrawn release whose mul_mod skipped a quotient digit. The research file gives no sha3-asm version for v1.0.10; that tag pins 0.1.6, which changes nothing here. I ran MULMOD on both endpoints with eth_call of initcode (a=b=2^256-1 mod 2^256-1, mod 2^256-2, and (2^256-2)(2^256-1) mod 2^256-1) and got 0, 1 and 0 on forno.celo.org (reth/v2.2.0-74cc8bb) and rpc.xlayer.tech, which matches exact arithmetic. FullMath.mulDiv takes mulmod(a, b, not(0)) for the high word, so the edge that the 1.21.0 fault hit computes correctly on both nodes.
